summary: Marks the agent tests folder as a package so its test files can import each other's helpers.
purpose: Declares the agent layer test folder. It has one line of description and no test logic.
why: Likely reason: it lets agent test files import shared helpers, such as the cartographer's sample output used by the budget tests.
how: Nothing runs from this file. Python reads it when agent test files are imported or collected.
risks: Low. Removing it could break cross-file imports between agent tests.
debug: If an agent test cannot import another agent test module, check this file exists.
